stages.discovery: A small cabin sits back from the road, its chimney trailing a thin line of smoke into the gray sky. Traps hang drying along the porch rail, and neat rows of herbs have been staked out beside the door - someone lives here on purpose, not by accident.

choices.label: Knock and Trade
choices.description: See if the hermit will part with any supplies
choices.outcome: The door opens on a wary old trapper who softens once you show you mean no trouble. He trades a bundle of dried herbs for a few coins, mutters something about the woods getting stranger lately, and closes the door before you can ask what he means.

choices.label: Ask About the Roads Ahead
choices.description: A hermit this far out would know the land
choices.outcome: He's cagey at first, but a little patience gets you a warning about a stretch of trail up ahead best avoided after dark - the kind of local knowledge that never makes it onto any map.

choices.label: Leave Him to His Traps
choices.description: ESC also cancels - he clearly prefers the quiet
choices.outcome: You give the cabin a respectful distance and let the hermit keep to himself.
